newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania holds Ukrainian ship in smuggling probe.
newsitem.headline: Romania holds Ukrainian ship in smuggling probe.

text.p: Authorities in Romania's Danube port of Galati have detained a Ukrainian ship on suspicion of attempting to smuggle some $1 million worth of cigarettes into the Balkan country, port officials said on Monday.
"The cargo ship Gloriya, sailing under the Ukrainian flag, has been detained pending investigations," port customs chief Virgil Popescu told Reuters from Galati, on the eastern border with Ukraine.

He said customs officials held the 500-tonne vessel, which was due to transit Romania to "a destination in Bulgaria", after routine checks showed it was carrying nearly 900,000 packets of Western cigarettes bearing Romanian duty stamps.
The cigarettes, with a market value of around $1 million, were unloaded into a Galati warehouse, local police said.
Romania introduced tobacco stamps last year, in a bid to crack down on widespread cigarette smuggling and tax evasion.
